items.text: Hey everyone, hope you’re doing well,

[p align="start"]A small update for FM27 is being rolled out now across all platforms supporting the Free Play Launch Preview. This update addresses a couple of reported issues that the team were able to identify, solve, and verify over the weekend:
Added a clickable scroll bar to the Advanced Setup screen to help players select clubs at the bottom of a league list
Resolved issue causing squad registration messages to sometimes not appear for UEFA club competitions, leading to unregistered senior players
Resolved issue causing the Save Game option to not be selectable if players experienced the issue above with UEFA squad registration not appearing
[p align="start"]As we covered last week, an additional FM27 update is planned, to support the full launch from 10 November, bringing further optimisations.

[p align="start"]Following this will be the game’s first post-launch update, where more player reports will be addressed. One area of focus here is the 3D match engine, where we’re combining internal data and player reports (including on defensive behaviour, pressing, chance creation and more) to establish what changes can and should be implemented.

[p align="start"]We’ll keep you posted on all of this on the way to FM27’s official launch and beyond. Thank you to everyone who has used our bug reporting system to report something; please continue to do this if you experience anything you’d like the team to investigate.
